Metadata.title: EloBoost: rank boosting and coaching
Metadata.description: Rank boosting and coaching for League of Legends, Valorant, TFT, CS2 and Overwatch 2 by verified high-elo players.

Home.title: Reach the rank you deserve
Home.subtitle: Verified high-elo boosters, encrypted account details and live order tracking, all in one place.

verified.title: Verified boosters
verified.body: Every booster is a manually approved high-elo player.

secure.title: Encrypted credentials
secure.body: Account logins are encrypted with AES-256 and only revealed to your booster.

tracking.title: Live tracking
tracking.body: Follow your progress and chat with your booster in real time.

Home.gamesSubtitle: Boosting and coaching for the most competitive games.

Footer.disclaimer: EloBoost is not affiliated with Riot Games, Valve or Blizzard.

REFUNDED.title: Refund in full
REFUNDED.body: Cancels the order and puts {total} in the customer's wallet. The booster isn't paid.

PARTIAL_REFUND.title: Partial refund
PARTIAL_REFUND.body: Refunds part of {total} to the wallet, closes the order and pays the booster for the rest.

REASSIGNED.title: Give to another booster
REASSIGNED.body: Removes the current booster and puts the order back in the pool.

CONTINUED.title: Continue the order
CONTINUED.body: Unfreezes the order where it stopped.

resolve.boosterShare: The booster receives about {amount} for the rest.
resolve.noteHint: Stored with the dispute and the audit log.
